title: ISP Tracking & DNS Privacy Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Calculate your ISP tracking risk level. Assess DNS privacy vulnerabilities and get personalized recommendations to protect your browsing data.
description: Evaluate how exposed you are to ISP tracking and DNS monitoring. This calculator analyzes your current setup and provides a privacy risk score with actionable steps to improve your DNS privacy and reduce ISP surveillance.

inputs.label: Internet Service Provider Type
inputs.helpText: Different ISP types have varying levels of monitoring capabilities

inputs.label: DNS Provider
inputs.helpText: Your DNS provider significantly impacts tracking exposure

inputs.label: VPN Usage
inputs.helpText: VPNs can significantly reduce ISP visibility into your activities

inputs.label: HTTPS Website Usage
inputs.helpText: Percentage of websites you visit that use HTTPS encryption

inputs.label: Browsing Patterns
inputs.helpText: Your browsing patterns affect the value of tracking data to ISPs

inputs.label: Privacy Tools Used
inputs.helpText: Do you use privacy-focused browsers like Incognito Browser or similar tools?

outputFields.label: Privacy Risk Score
outputFields.description: Overall ISP tracking risk level (0-100, lower is better)

outputFields.label: Tracking Exposure
outputFields.description: Percentage of activity potentially visible to ISP

formula: let baseRisk = 60; const ispMultiplier = { 'commercial': 1.0, 'government': 1.4, 'corporate': 1.2, 'public': 1.6 }[ispType]; const dnsRisk = { 'isp-default': 40, 'public-unencrypted': 30, 'public-encrypted': 10, 'private-vpn': 5 }[dnsProvider]; const vpnReduction = { 'never': 0, 'sometimes': 0.2, 'most-time': 0.6, 'always': 0.8 }[vpnUsage]; const httpsProtection = httpsUsage * 0.3; const habitRisk = { 'routine': 0, 'varied': 10, 'privacy-conscious': -15, 'high-risk': 25 }[browsingHabits]; const toolsReduction = privacyTools ? 15 : 0; const adjustedRisk = (baseRisk * ispMultiplier) + dnsRisk + habitRisk - (vpnReduction * 40) - (httpsProtection * 0.4) - toolsReduction; const riskScore = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(adjustedRisk))); const riskLevel = riskScore >= 70 ? 'HIGH' : riskScore >= 40 ? 'MEDIUM' : 'LOW'; const dnsRiskPercent = Math.round((dnsRisk / 40) * 100); const trackingExposure = Math.max(10, Math.min(90, Math.round(riskScore * 0.8 + (100 - httpsUsage) * 0.3))); return { riskScore, riskLevel, dnsRisk: dnsRiskPercent, trackingExposure };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates ISP tracking risk based on your network setup, DNS configuration, and privacy practices. It considers factors like ISP type, DNS provider security, VPN usage, HTTPS adoption, and privacy tool usage to estimate how much of your internet activity may be visible to your ISP.
tips: Switch to DNS over HTTPS (DoH) or DNS over TLS (DoT) to encrypt DNS queries
Use Incognito Browser or similar privacy-focused browsers for sensitive browsing
Consider a reputable VPN service to hide traffic from your ISP
Always look for HTTPS (lock icon) when entering sensitive information
Use privacy-focused DNS providers like Cloudflare (1.1.1.1) or Quad9
Avoid using your ISP's default DNS servers when possible
Be extra cautious on public WiFi networks

interpretation.label: LOW RISK
interpretation.description: Good privacy practices in place. Your ISP has limited visibility into your browsing activities.

interpretation.label: MEDIUM RISK
interpretation.description: Some privacy gaps exist. Your ISP can track portions of your internet activity.

interpretation.label: HIGH RISK
interpretation.description: Significant privacy exposure. Your ISP can monitor most of your internet activities and DNS queries.
